title: Server meds
body:
This mod ads various meds to minecraft
such as medicaments such as:
> morphine - gives player absorption but has a chance to cause addiction
>
> eucalyptus extract - a natural pain relieving and anti-inflammatory drug that gives resistance
> 
>  caffeine - speed and haste
> 
> bandage - quick regeneration
> 
> medkit - heals a lot of hp and gives absorption


Plans for next updates:
- New medical items
- Health system
- Crafting recipes
- Integration with other mods ([Curios API](https://modrinth.com/mod/curios) and [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create))
- Toxins
- Plants and Crops
- Recipe fixes
